hotspots.title: Reopen the Great Gash
hotspots.employer: Federated Commonwealth — AFFC Fourth Wave relief command (Tamar March)
hotspots.blurb: Ride the September counterattack onto Twycross — break into the Great Gash canyons the Falcons hold and take the fight to the Jade Falcon Guards before the Diabolis blows.
hotspots.situation:
Twycross fell in June. The Jade Falcon Guards came down on the Plain of Curtains, the militia held three weeks on a desert world where the sand itself is a weapon, and then the militia was gone. What the Falcons took was not a prize so much as a door: from Twycross the Tamar March lies open, and the Trellshire plant under Doom Valley builds the machines that were supposed to close it.

In September the Commonwealth comes back. Two regiments and the Kell Hounds are lifting for a counterattack that everyone on the staff knows is the first real test of whether the Inner Sphere can take a world back from the Clans at all. The plan turns on the Great Gash, the belt of deep canyons south of the Plain, where the Falcon Guards have laagered out of the wind. Get into the canyons and the Guards have to fight on ground that cancels their range. Fail, and the assault force is caught on the open Plain when the Diabolis sandstorm comes through, and the Diabolis does not care whose colors you wear.

Your command is hired as the assault's leading edge on the eastern canyon mouths — the cut nobody wants because the Falcons will bid their best against whoever comes through it first. The AFFC liaison is honest about it: you are there to be the hammer that makes the Guards turn, so the Hounds can take them from the flank. Break in, hold the canyon floor, and the Guards are trapped between you and the Plain. Break, and the counterattack goes back to its ships with nothing but a lesson.

contract.constraints: Command House (an AFFC liaison rides the assault; the axis is the Gash and nothing else). Salvage cannot exceed Shared — captured Clan hardware goes to the NAIS before you see a share.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; minimum fielded force 6,000 BV / 240 PV. Desert-capable — no unit may deploy without heat management for a 65°C equator.
contract.bonus: First through the Gash — if your command holds the canyon floor at the end of Track 1, the AFFC pays a spearhead bonus of +1 Reputation and a Clan-salvage voucher (one captured OmniMech chassis released to you at contract end, if any are taken).

missionBrief.behindScenes: The Guards have laagered in the Gash to wait out the Diabolis season; they did not expect the Commonwealth back this soon. Star Colonel Pryde bids two Trinaries against your entry — Clan pride, not caution. If Track 1 breaks her, she pulls toward the Plain and the Hounds catch her there (Track 2a). If she holds, she counter-bids and comes down the canyon at you (Track 2b). Either way the Diabolis is the clock: it arrives at the Track 3 laager whether anyone is ready.

complications.effect: None.

Zellbrigen. A Falcon MechWarrior challenges your commander by name over open channel. Accept: the two fight one-on-one and no other unit may fire on either until one is crippled. Refuse or interfere: the Falcons abandon honor rules for the track and concentrate fire freely.
Diabolis edge. A sandstorm front crosses the map from Turn 4 — visibility 3 hexes, +2 to-hit at range, no aerospace or artillery. Both sides.
Elemental Point in the rocks. Five Elementals begin hidden in canyon-wall hexes of the Falcon side; they reveal when a friendly unit ends its move adjacent.
Liaison push. The AFFC liaison commits one of your units to the canyon mouth early — it deploys 4 hexes forward of your line on Turn 1.
Roll twice, ignore repeats.

missionBrief.contractVictory: Hold the Great Gash canyon floor at the end of Track 1 and deny the Jade Falcon Guards their laager in Track 3. Track 2 is pursuit or survival; the contract pays on whether the Guards are still an organized force when the Diabolis arrives.
missionBrief.tally: Canyon Wall — each of your units that ends Track 1 crippled or destroyed counts 1. At 3+, the Hounds cannot exploit the breach: Track 2a is unavailable and the tree goes to 2b regardless of outcome.

namedCharacters.name: Star Colonel Vanya Pryde
namedCharacters.role: OpFor commander — Jade Falcon Guards detachment
namedCharacters.rule: Joins from Track 1. Will accept any zellbrigen challenge from your commander. If crippled, the Falcon force is -2 Initiative for the rest of that track and does not counter-bid in Track 2b.

namedCharacters.name: Leftenant Bram Okonkwo
namedCharacters.role: AFFC liaison — 10th Lyran Guards
namedCharacters.rule: Rides with your command from Track 1. May be committed by the Liaison-push complication. If destroyed, no spearhead bonus is paid.

missionBrief.purchaseOptions: Between tracks, buy from an AFFC counterattack list — medium and heavy 'Mechs only, on a 2D6 roll of 8+ (-1 per unit lost to the Canyon Wall tally). No Clan hardware.

tracks.name: Into the Gash
tracks.situation:
The eastern canyon mouths. Two Falcon Trinaries hold the floor where the walls close to sixty meters. You go in; they have bid to stop you.

Assault: you (Attacker) must break in and hold ground. The canyon walls block line of sight beyond 6 hexes on the interior — range is nothing here, position is everything.
tracks.deployment: Short edges. The Falcons (Defender) set up within 8 hexes of their home edge on the canyon floor; canyon-wall hexes are impassable Level 4 terrain. You (Attacker) enter Turn 1 from your short edge. No Battlefield Support air this track (the walls); artillery permitted from Turn 3.

objectives.text: Breach — get half your force by BV/PV past the first canyon narrows by end of Turn 4.
Hold the Floor — more non-crippled BV/PV in the canyon interior than the Falcons at end of Turn 8.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Colonel Pryde's Summoner.
Deny the Breach — no attacker unit past the narrows at end of Turn 4.

tracks.specialRules: Canyon interior: no line of sight beyond 6 hexes. Every friendly unit crippled or destroyed this track adds to the Canyon Wall tally.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8, or when one side has no non-crippled 'Mechs in the canyon interior.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Shared — Clan wrecks go to NAIS custody; you receive the SP value of your salvage share in cash, and the voucher if earned.

forks.trigger: You hold the canyon floor; the Guards are pulling toward the Plain.
forks.consequence: The Hounds are on their flank — run them onto the Plain before the storm.

forks.trigger: You are stalled in the narrows; Pryde has counter-bid.
forks.consequence: The Falcons come down the canyon at you. Hold the mouth or the assault dies here.

tracks.name: Onto the Plain
tracks.situation: The Guards are retreating up the Gash toward the Plain of Curtains, where the Hounds wait. Catch them in the canyon exits and the trap closes. Let them reach open sand and they can still fight the Hounds on their own terms.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Falcons (Defender) set up in the northern third, moving toward their home edge; you (Attacker) enter Turn 1 from the south. Canyon-exit hexes along the Falcon edge are the objective terrain.

objectives.text: Run Them Down — engage half the Falcon force before it reaches the exit hexes.
Close the Exits — hold two of the three canyon-exit hexes at end of Turn 6.
Hammer — first side to cripple 25% of the enemy scores it; simultaneous, both score.
Reach the Plain — exit half the Falcon force by BV off the Falcon home edge.

tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 6, or when the Falcons have no non-crippled unit south of the exit hexes.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Pool-draft (wrecks pooled, alternate picks, winner first); Clan wrecks to NAIS, cash to you.

forks.trigger: What survived has fallen back on the Guards' supply laager.
forks.consequence: One target left, and the Diabolis is an hour out.

tracks.name: Hold the Mouth
tracks.situation: Pryde counter-bid and is coming down the canyon at the entry you were supposed to take. If she reaches the mouth, the assault is over and the Hounds are exposed on the Plain.
tracks.deployment: Short edges. You (Defender) set up within 6 hexes of the canyon mouth on your home edge; the Falcons (Attacker) enter Turn 1 from the interior. Canyon walls impassable. No aerospace.

objectives.text: Hold the Mouth — half your force within 4 hexes of the canyon mouth at end of Turn 3.
Overpower — more non-crippled BV/PV within 6 hexes of the mouth than the Falcons at end of Turn 6.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Colonel Pryde's Summoner.
Break Out — exit a third of the Falcon force by BV off your home edge.

tracks.specialRules: Canyon interior: no line of sight beyond 6 hexes. Every friendly unit crippled or destroyed adds to the Canyon Wall tally.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 6, or when one side has no non-crippled 'Mechs within 6 hexes of the mouth.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Winner-all (paid as SP at your salvage %); Clan wrecks to NAIS custody.

forks.trigger: The canyon fight is decided; both sides fall back on the laager.
forks.consequence: Whatever is left, the Diabolis decides the last hour.

tracks.name: The Laager Before the Storm
tracks.situation: The Falcon Guards' supply laager sits in a wide bowl at the Gash's northern end — fuel, ammunition, the mobile field repair bays that keep OmniMechs fighting. The Diabolis is coming. Wreck the laager before it arrives and the Guards cannot re-arm; when the storm clears the Hounds finish them.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Falcons (Defender) set up in their own half with four Medium buildings (Level 2, 30 damage / AS 6) near center — the repair bays; one is secretly the ammunition store (HQ). You (Attacker) enter half on your home edge Turn 1, the rest from a short edge Turn 2. Diabolis front arrives Turn 7: visibility 3 hexes, +2 to-hit at range, both sides.

objectives.text: Case the Laager — scan 2 buildings, or find the ammunition store.
Identify and Destroy — after scanning it, destroy the ammunition store.
Rough Up the Place — destroy half the buildings.
Hold the Bays — half the Falcon force within reach of the buildings at end of Turn 6.
Seek and Destroy — cripple or destroy your command's unit.

tracks.specialRules: Building scans use the Strike reveal rules. The ammunition store, if destroyed, detonates: 20 damage to every unit within 2 hexes. From Turn 7 the Diabolis rules apply. At contract close: laager wrecked and Canyon Wall under 3 = +1 Reputation with the AFFC.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10, or when the ammunition store is destroyed and no Falcon unit is within 3 hexes of a standing building.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Pool-draft; Clan wrecks to NAIS, cash to you. The spearhead voucher pays here if earned.

forks.trigger: The storm has the Plain. The counterattack is decided.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; tally the Canyon Wall and settle Reputation and the voucher.

hotspots.title: The Limbo Flats
hotspots.employer: Federated Commonwealth — Needgate Militia (Limbo continent detachment)
hotspots.blurb: The Falcons are landing a second Cluster on Limbo to turn the Pandora line. The militia hires you to hit the landing zone from the rain country before it finishes unloading.
hotspots.situation:
Pandora is where the Commonwealth means to stop losing. February 3052, the Fifth Wave: Clan Jade Falcon has come for the world, and for once the defense is not a militia and a prayer. The Gray Death Legion is here, the Tenth FedCom is here, and on the main continent of Kaos the line in front of Needgate is holding. The Falcons know it. So they are doing what the Clans do when a wall stands — they go around it.

A second Falcon Cluster is landing on Limbo, the scarred continent across the strait, where the flatlands of Arcadia run right up to the causeway into Kaos. If that Cluster gets ashore, sorts itself out, and rolls up the causeway, the Needgate line is taken from behind while the Legion is still facing front. The militia detachment on Limbo is two companies of second-line 'Mechs and a great deal of rain. They cannot stop a Cluster. They can, with help, hit it while it is still on the beach.

That is your contract. The militia commander has no liaison to spare and no illusions: your command is to come out of the tree line on the Arcadia flats, hit the Falcon landing zone while the DropShips are still unloading, and make the Cluster fight for its beachhead instead of marching. Every hour you cost them is an hour the Legion has to finish the front. If the landing gets organized, the militia will fall back on the causeway, and you will be the only thing between the Falcons and the rear of the whole defense.

contract.constraints: Command Independent — the militia has no liaison to give you; you run your own fight and report by radio. Salvage Shared; the Commonwealth claims any intact Clan hardware for the NAIS.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; minimum fielded force 5,000 BV / 200 PV. Tropical rain country — units must be able to operate in heavy rain and mud (no hover vehicles).
contract.bonus: Beachhead spoiled — if the Falcon Cluster has not exited the landing zone by the end of Track 1, the FedCom pays +1 Reputation and a resupply of ammunition and armor at Commonwealth cost.

missionBrief.behindScenes: The Limbo Cluster is a Trinary short — the Falcons bid low because they expected militia. Your presence breaks their bid. Star Captain Hazen will re-bid upward if Track 1 goes badly for her, which is why 2b is harder than 2a. The causeway in Track 3 is the real prize: if the Falcons take it, the campaign on Pandora is lost regardless of what the Legion does on Kaos.

complications.effect: None.
Zellbrigen. A Falcon warrior challenges your commander. Accept: one-on-one until one is crippled, no interference. Refuse or interfere: the Falcons drop honor rules and mass fire for the track.
Monsoon. Heavy rain all track — visibility 5 hexes, +1 to-hit at medium and long range, all clear terrain is mud (+1 MP to enter). Both sides.
Unloaded early. One Falcon Star is already off the ships and deployed at the LZ edge before Turn 1.
Militia flank. One militia lance (medium 'Mechs, Regular) enters from your short edge on Turn 3 as reinforcements, under your command.
Roll twice, ignore repeats.

missionBrief.contractVictory: Prevent the Falcon Cluster from taking the Arcadia causeway into Kaos across all tracks. The beachhead bonus pays on Track 1 alone; the contract pays on whether the causeway is still Commonwealth ground when the tree closes.
missionBrief.tally: Causeway Clock — each track the Falcons win advances the Cluster one stage toward the causeway. At 2, Track 3 begins with the Falcons already holding the near end.

namedCharacters.name: Star Captain Rhea Hazen
namedCharacters.role: OpFor commander — Jade Falcon Limbo detachment
namedCharacters.rule: Joins from Track 1. Will accept zellbrigen. If crippled, the Falcons do not re-bid in Track 2b and enter Track 3 one Star short.

namedCharacters.name: Kommandant Ilse Varga
namedCharacters.role: Needgate Militia — Limbo detachment commander
namedCharacters.rule: Not on the field in Track 1. Enters with the militia in Track 3 under your command. If destroyed, the militia lances are -1 Initiative for the rest of the track.

missionBrief.purchaseOptions: Between tracks, buy from a Commonwealth garrison list — light and medium 'Mechs and tracked vehicles only, on a 2D6 roll of 8+. No Clan hardware.

tracks.name: Out of the Tree Line
tracks.situation:
The Falcon DropShips are down on the Arcadia flats, half unloaded, the LZ a mess of Elementals and OmniMechs sorting into Stars. You come out of the rain forest on their flank before they finish.

Flank: you (Attacker) hit an enemy that is not set. Every turn they spend forming up under fire is a turn the beachhead is not a beachhead.
tracks.deployment: You (Attacker) enter from a long edge on Turn 1 through forest hexes (the tree line — Heavy Woods for the first 3 hexes of your edge). The Falcons (Defender) set up in the open within 6 hexes of the opposite long edge; half their force begins on the DropShip hexes (Level 3 buildings, impassable) and may not move until Turn 2. No aerospace.

objectives.text: Hit Them Forming — cripple or destroy one Falcon unit before the end of Turn 2.
Pin the Beachhead — more non-crippled BV/PV near the DropShips than the Falcons at end of Turn 6.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Captain Hazen's Hellbringer.
Form Up — every Falcon unit off the DropShips and formed in Stars by end of Turn 4.
Push Off — exit a third of the Falcon force by BV off your entry edge.

tracks.specialRules: Falcon units on DropShip hexes may fire from Turn 1 but not move until Turn 2. A Falcon track win advances the Causeway Clock.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 6, or when no Falcon unit remains within 6 hexes of the DropShips.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Shared — Clan wrecks to NAIS custody; you receive your salvage share in cash. Beachhead bonus pays here if earned.

forks.trigger: The landing is spoiled; the Falcons are pulling back to the ships to re-form.
forks.consequence: Hazen will try again from the coast road. Catch the Stars strung out on the move.

forks.trigger: The Cluster got organized; Hazen has re-bid and is coming for you.
forks.consequence: Fall back on Arcadia town and make the flats cost them.

tracks.name: The Coast Road
tracks.situation: Hazen has given up the beach and is moving her Stars along the coast road toward the causeway, strung out by the terrain. Catch them on the move and the Cluster never arrives as a Cluster.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Falcons (Defender) set up in a column along the road in the northern third, moving toward their home edge; you (Attacker) enter Turn 1 from the south through forest. Road hexes are paved (+1 MP for wheeled/tracked); off-road is mud.

objectives.text: Run Them Down — engage half the Falcon force before it reaches the causeway-approach hexes.
Cut the Column — no two Falcon units within 3 hexes of each other after Turn 3.
Hammer — first side to cripple 25% of the enemy scores it; simultaneous, both score.
Reach the Approach — exit half the Falcon force by BV off the Falcon home edge.

tracks.specialRules: A Falcon track win advances the Causeway Clock.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 6, or when the Falcons have no non-crippled unit on the road.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Pool-draft; Clan wrecks to NAIS, cash to you.

forks.trigger: What is left of the Cluster reaches the causeway.
forks.consequence: The militia is on the causeway. Hold it with them.

tracks.name: Arcadia Town
tracks.situation: The beach is theirs. You are falling back across the flats on Arcadia, the militia's rain-soaked garrison town, with a re-bid Cluster behind you. Get your command through the town and onto the causeway road before Hazen closes it.
tracks.deployment: Short edges, same-edge start. You (Defender) enter from the Falcon edge Turn 1; the Falcons (Attacker) enter their own edge Turn 2. Arcadia town is a cluster of Light buildings (Level 1) at center; road exits on your home edge.

objectives.text: Break Contact — exit at least one of your units off your home edge.
Gauntlet — exit half your force by count off your home edge; crippled units that make it count.
Hammer — first side to cripple 25% of the enemy scores it; simultaneous, both score.
Run Them Down — engage half your units in the town by end of Turn 4.

tracks.specialRules: A Falcon track win advances the Causeway Clock.
tracks.trackEnd: Turn 10.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Defender keeps none unless the Attacker fails to win; then owners recover their own.

forks.trigger: You are on the causeway road with the Falcons behind you.
forks.consequence: The militia is on the causeway. Hold it with them, on the back foot.

tracks.name: The Arcadia Causeway
tracks.situation: The causeway is four kilometers of raised road across the strait to Kaos — the only way a Cluster crosses without ships. Behind you the Legion is winning at Needgate. If the Falcons take this road, that stops mattering. Kommandant Varga's militia is dug in at the near abutment; you hold with them.
tracks.deployment: Short edges. You (Defender) and the militia set up within 6 hexes of the causeway abutment on your home edge; the causeway itself is a 2-hex-wide paved strip running off your edge (units on it may not be attacked from the strait sides — the water is Depth 2). The Falcons (Attacker) enter Turn 1. If the Causeway Clock is at 2, the Falcons instead set up holding the abutment and you enter Turn 1.

objectives.text: Hold the Abutment — half your force within 3 hexes of the abutment at end of Turn 4.
Overpower — more non-crippled BV/PV within 6 hexes of the abutment than the Falcons at end of Turn 8.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Captain Hazen's Hellbringer.
Onto the Road — exit a third of the Falcon force by BV along the causeway off your home edge.

tracks.specialRules: The militia (two lances, medium 'Mechs, Regular) fights under your command. At contract close: causeway held = +1 Reputation with the Commonwealth; causeway lost = -1 Reputation and the Legion's line at Needgate is flanked.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8, or when one side has no non-crippled 'Mechs within 6 hexes of the abutment.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Winner-all (paid as SP at your salvage %); Clan wrecks to NAIS custody.

forks.trigger: The causeway is decided.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle the Causeway Clock and Reputation.

hotspots.title: The Hammarr Lift
hotspots.employer: Lyran Commonwealth — Sudeten Militia (Hammarr port authority, last-lift command)
hotspots.blurb: Sudeten is lost. The Legion is lifting and a militia company is dying at the spaceport to buy it time. You are hired to hold the last DropShip pad at Hammarr until the people who can still get out have gone.
hotspots.situation:
Sudeten is one of the industrial anchors of the Tamar March — refurbished 'Mech plants, a spaceport built to move regiments — and in September 3050 the Jade Falcons decided they wanted it. The Gray Death Legion and the Sudeten Militia have been fighting a delaying action for a month, trading ground for time in the hope of mauling the 124th Striker Cluster badly enough to matter. It has not been enough. In October the word comes down: the world cannot be held, and the Legion is lifting.

The lift is at Hammarr Space Port, and the Falcons know it. A militia 'Mech company has gone forward to meet the Falcon vanguard in the open, with orders no one had to write down — hold long enough for the DropShips to load. They will not come back. What they buy is a window, and the window has a back edge: the last ships out carry the plant engineers, the militia's wounded, and the port authority's families. Those ships are not military and they are not fast. Somebody has to hold the last pad while they load.

That somebody is you. The port authority is paying out of its own reserve, because the Commonwealth is already gone and the Legion cannot spare a lance. Your command holds the southern pad approaches from the moment the militia company breaks until the last civilian ship lifts. There is no relief and no counterattack. There is a clock, a Clan Cluster, and a set of DropShip ramps that close when the loadmaster says they close. Get the people out, then get yourself out.

contract.constraints: Command Independent — there is no one left to give orders. Salvage None: nothing can be recovered from a world that is being abandoned, and the port authority does not pretend otherwise.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; minimum fielded force 4,500 BV / 180 PV. Your own DropShip must be on the southern pad and able to lift on 15 minutes' notice.
contract.bonus: Every ship lifts — if all three civilian DropShips lift full across the contract, the port authority pays +2 Reputation with the Lyran Commonwealth and a transport credit covering your own lift. The Legion notices who held the pad.

missionBrief.behindScenes: The Falcons are not trying to stop the lift — Clan honor does not fight refugees. They are trying to catch the Legion's rear guard and any militia 'Mechs still on the ground, and your command reads to them as exactly that. Star Commander Kael will bid to take you as isorla. If you hold the pad in Track 1 the loadmaster gets all three ships up and the tree goes to a fighting withdrawal (2a). If the pad falls, the third ship is cut off on the northern field and you must break through to it (2b).

complications.effect: None.
Zellbrigen. A Falcon warrior challenges your commander. Accept: one-on-one until one is crippled. Refuse or interfere: the Falcons drop honor rules for the track.
Slow load. The second civilian ship's ramp jams. Its lift is delayed 2 turns; the pad must be held 2 turns longer than the track states.
Militia survivors. Two militia 'Mechs (Regular, damaged — half armor) stagger onto the pad from the north on Turn 2 and fight under your command.
Elementals on the fence. A Point of five Elementals infiltrates the port perimeter; they begin hidden in any building hex on the Falcon side and reveal when adjacent to a friendly unit.
Roll twice, ignore repeats.

missionBrief.contractVictory: All three civilian DropShips lift from Hammarr, and your command lifts after them. Nothing else on Sudeten can be won. The contract pays on ships away, not ground held.
missionBrief.tally: Ships Away — each civilian DropShip that lifts full counts 1. At 3, the bonus pays. At 1 or fewer, -1 Reputation: the port authority remembers who could not hold.

namedCharacters.name: Star Commander Kael
namedCharacters.role: OpFor commander — 124th Striker Cluster vanguard Star
namedCharacters.rule: Joins from Track 1. Will accept zellbrigen; will NOT fire on DropShips or civilian vehicles. If crippled, the Falcon vanguard halts for 2 turns before resuming.

namedCharacters.name: Loadmaster Petra Holcomb
namedCharacters.role: Hammarr port authority — controls the lift schedule
namedCharacters.rule: Not a combatant. The tower is a Level 2 Medium building at the pad edge; if it is destroyed, every ship's lift is delayed 1 turn.

missionBrief.purchaseOptions: None. There is nothing to buy on a world being abandoned.

tracks.name: The Southern Pad
tracks.situation:
The militia company has broken. The Falcon vanguard is coming down the port road. Three civilian ships are loading on the southern pad and the loadmaster has the ramps on a timer. You hold until they lift, then you go.

Retreat: you (Defender) are buying time, not ground. The objective is ships in the air.
tracks.deployment: Short edges. You (Defender) set up within 6 hexes of the pad on your home edge; the three DropShips are Level 3 buildings on the pad, impassable, and lift on Turns 4, 6 and 8 (each lifts only if no Falcon unit is within 2 hexes of it that turn — otherwise it waits a turn). The Falcons (Attacker) enter Turn 1. No aerospace either side.

objectives.text: First Ship Away — the first DropShip lifts on schedule (Turn 4).
All Ships Away — all three DropShips lift by end of Turn 10.
Break Contact — exit half your force by count off your home edge after the last ship lifts.
Isorla — cripple or destroy a third of your force by count before the last ship lifts.
Ground the Third — the third DropShip has not lifted by end of Turn 10.

tracks.specialRules: Falcon units will not fire on DropShips. Each ship that lifts full adds to Ships Away. Slow-load complication delays the second ship 2 turns.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10, or when all three ships have lifted and no friendly unit remains within 6 hexes of the pad.
tracks.salvagePolicy: None. Nothing is recovered.

forks.trigger: All three ships are up. Your own ship is waiting.
forks.consequence: Kael is still coming. Get to your ramp with the Falcons on your heels.

forks.trigger: The third ship could not lift from the southern pad; it has diverted to the northern field.
forks.consequence: Break through the Falcon line to reach it before its window closes.

tracks.name: Your Own Ramp
tracks.situation: The civilians are away. Your DropShip is on the far pad with its ramp down, and Kael's Star is between you and it. You are the last thing on Sudeten the Falcons want.
tracks.deployment: Short edges, same-edge start. You (Defender) enter from the Falcon edge Turn 1; the Falcons (Attacker) enter their own edge Turn 2. Your DropShip is a Level 3 building on your home edge; units that reach a hex adjacent to it and end their move there have boarded.

objectives.text: Board — exit half your force by count into the DropShip.
Leave No One — every non-crippled friendly unit boards by end of Turn 8.
Hammer — first side to cripple 25% of the enemy scores it; simultaneous, both score.
Isorla — cripple or destroy a third of your force before it boards.

tracks.specialRules: Boarded units are removed from play and cannot be attacked. The DropShip lifts at end of Turn 8 with whoever is aboard.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8.
tracks.salvagePolicy: None.

forks.trigger: The ship lifts. Sudeten is behind you.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Ships Away and Reputation.

tracks.name: The Northern Field
tracks.situation: The third ship diverted to the old northern landing field with a hundred people aboard and no cover. Kael's Star sits between you and it. Get through, and the ship lifts with you on the pad. Fail, and it lifts without you, or not at all.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Falcons (Defender) set up within 6 hexes of their edge across the port road; you (Attacker) enter Turn 1. The third DropShip is a Level 3 building on the Falcon home edge; it lifts at end of Turn 8 if any friendly unit is adjacent to it that turn.

objectives.text: Cross the Line — get half your force by BV/PV across the center line.
Reach the Ship — one friendly unit adjacent to the third DropShip at end of Turn 8.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Commander Kael's Mad Dog.
You Shall Not Pass — cripple half the attacking force before any unit reaches the ship.

tracks.specialRules: If the ship lifts with a friendly unit adjacent, Ships Away counts 3. If it lifts without one, it counts 2 and your command is stranded: -1 Reputation and your own lift is at your own cost.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8.
tracks.salvagePolicy: None.

forks.trigger: The last ship is up or it is not.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Ships Away and Reputation.

hotspots.title: Reykjavik Stands
hotspots.employer: Free Rasalhague Republic — KungsArmé (Reykjavik government-district command)
hotspots.blurb: Clan Wolf is in the capital and the Drakøns are broken. Hold the ministry line in Reykjavik long enough for the Republic's archive and succession to get out — then decide what the last block is worth.
hotspots.situation:
The Free Rasalhague Republic is twelve years old and it is dying on its own capital. July 3050: Clan Wolf has landed on Rasalhague, and the fighting is in the streets of Reykjavik itself. The Drakøns, the Republic's best, met the Wolves in the open and were shattered. What is left of the KungsArmé is falling back through the city, block by block, and the government district is the last ground that means anything.

It means something because of what is in it. The Republic's archive — the treaties, the land registers, the records that make Rasalhague a nation and not a province — is being loaded onto trucks in the ministry courtyards. So is the line of succession. If the archive and the heirs reach the port, the Republic survives somewhere, in exile, as an idea that can come back. If the Wolves take the district before the convoy clears, the Free Rasalhague Republic ends where it began.

The district commander has one battalion of militia, the wreck of a Drakøn company, and your contract. You hold the ministry line — the ring of government buildings around the courtyards — while the convoy loads. When it moves, you cover its road to the port. The Wolves are not burning the city; they fight for the ground, and they have offered the district a Trial rather than a siege. The commander has not answered yet. Whether he does may depend on how you hold.

contract.constraints: Command House — the district commander directs the line; his liaison rides with you. Salvage Exchange: whatever is recovered from the district belongs to a Republic that may not exist tomorrow; you take cash.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; minimum fielded force 5,500 BV / 220 PV. Urban — no unit may deploy that cannot fight inside a city.
contract.bonus: The archive clears — if the convoy reaches the port intact across the tree, the Republic-in-exile pays +2 Reputation with the FRR and a standing retainer offer for the resistance to come.

missionBrief.behindScenes: Star Colonel Ward is fighting for the district, not the city; the Wolves have already decided Rasalhague is theirs and are treating the capital as a prize to be kept intact. Ward bids one Trinary against the ministry line. If you hold (Track 1), the militia counterattacks the block the Wolves broke on the flank (2a). If the line bends, the convoy rolls early and you cover it (2b). Either way Ward offers a Trial for the last block in Track 3 — his respect, and his impatience, are both real.

complications.effect: None.
Zellbrigen. A Wolf warrior challenges your commander. Accept: one-on-one until one is crippled. Refuse or interfere: the Wolves drop honor rules for the track.
Convoy under fire. One archive truck breaks down in a courtyard hex; a friendly unit must end a move adjacent to it to get it moving again, or the archive counts as one truck short.
Drakøn remnant. Two Drakøn 'Mechs (Veteran, half armor) join your line on Turn 2 under your command. They will not retreat.
Elementals in the ministries. A Point of five Elementals begins hidden in any Level 2+ building hex on the Wolf side; reveals when adjacent to a friendly unit.
Roll twice, ignore repeats.

missionBrief.contractVictory: The archive convoy reaches the port intact and the Republic's succession lifts. The ministry line is a means; the convoy is the contract. Track 3's Trial, if accepted and won, buys the convoy clean passage regardless of Track 2.
missionBrief.tally: Archive Trucks — the convoy is four trucks; each destroyed or abandoned counts -1. At -2, the bonus does not pay. At -4, the Republic's records are lost: -2 Reputation.

namedCharacters.name: Star Colonel Marek Ward
namedCharacters.role: OpFor commander — Clan Wolf Reykjavik detachment
namedCharacters.rule: Joins from Track 1. Will accept zellbrigen and honors its terms strictly. Will NOT fire on the archive trucks. In Track 3 he fights the Trial in person.

namedCharacters.name: Överste Lars Thorvaldsen
namedCharacters.role: KungsArmé — government-district commander
namedCharacters.rule: On the field from Track 1 as the liaison. If destroyed, the militia battalion is -2 Initiative for the rest of the track and Track 3's Trial is unavailable (no one left to accept it).

missionBrief.purchaseOptions: Between tracks, buy from what the KungsArmé can still issue — light and medium 'Mechs and infantry transports only, on a 2D6 roll of 9+. Nothing heavy is left.

tracks.name: The Ministry Line
tracks.situation:
The ring of government buildings around the archive courtyards. The Wolves come down the boulevards; you hold the ring while the trucks load.

Defend: you (Defender) hold ground against a stronger enemy. The buildings are yours; the streets are theirs.
tracks.deployment: Short edges. You (Defender) set up within 6 hexes of your home edge; six Medium buildings (Level 2, 30 damage / AS 6) at center are the ministry ring, and the two courtyard hexes inside it are the loading zone. The Wolves (Attacker) enter Turn 1 down two boulevard (paved) lanes. No aerospace; artillery permitted to neither side inside the ring.

objectives.text: Hold the Ring — half your force within 3 hexes of the ministry buildings at end of Turn 4.
Overpower — more non-crippled BV/PV inside the ring than the Wolves at end of Turn 8.
Keep the Courtyards — no Wolf unit in a courtyard hex at end of any turn.
Breach the Ring — a Wolf unit in a courtyard hex at end of any turn from Turn 5.

tracks.specialRules: Ministry buildings are cover for both sides. The archive trucks are loading in the courtyards from Turn 1 and are not targets — but a Wolf unit in a courtyard hex halts loading that turn.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8, or when the Wolves hold both courtyard hexes at end of a turn.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Exchange — cash to you at 1/4 value; the Republic keeps nothing it cannot carry.

forks.trigger: The ring held; the Wolves broke one block on the flank and are holding it.
forks.consequence: Thorvaldsen wants that block back before the convoy moves. Take it.

forks.trigger: The ring is breached; the convoy is rolling early and half-loaded.
forks.consequence: Cover the archive's road to the port with the Wolves inside the district.

tracks.name: The Broken Block
tracks.situation: One Wolf Star took the Treasury block on the flank and is dug in. If it stays, the convoy's road passes under its guns. Thorvaldsen wants it cleared before the trucks roll — block by block, building by building.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Wolves (Defender) set up within 4 hexes of the Treasury block — four Medium buildings (Level 2) on their side of center. You (Attacker) enter Turn 1 from your home edge. Streets are paved; building hexes Level 2.

objectives.text: Push — hold two of the four Treasury buildings at end of Turn 5.
Clear the Block — no non-crippled Wolf unit within 2 hexes of any Treasury building at end of Turn 8.
Hammer — first side to cripple 25% of the enemy scores it; simultaneous, both score.
Hold the Block — a Wolf unit within 2 hexes of a Treasury building at end of Turn 8.

tracks.specialRules: Buildings destroyed this track do not affect the archive.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Pool-draft; Exchange cash to you.

forks.trigger: Ward has sent a herald. He offers a Trial for the last block.
forks.consequence: Accept and fight him for the convoy's road, or refuse and take the road by force.

tracks.name: The Archive Road
tracks.situation: The ring is gone. Four trucks are on the boulevard to the port with half the archive aboard and the Wolves inside the district behind them. You are the convoy's rear guard and its only guard.
tracks.deployment: Short edges, same-edge start. You (Defender) and the four trucks enter from the Wolf edge Turn 1 — trucks are wheeled, 4 MP, 10 armor, and must exit your home edge; the Wolves (Attacker) enter their own edge Turn 2. Boulevard is paved; side streets Level 1 buildings.

objectives.text: Trucks Through — exit three of four trucks off your home edge.
Gauntlet — exit half your force by count off your home edge; crippled units that make it count.
Hammer — first side to cripple 25% of the enemy scores it; simultaneous, both score.
Stop the Convoy — two or more trucks destroyed or immobilized before exiting.

tracks.specialRules: Wolf units will not deliberately fire on trucks (Ward's rule) but trucks in a hex with a friendly unit take splash from area weapons. Each truck lost adds to Archive Trucks.
tracks.trackEnd: Turn 10, or when every truck has exited or been destroyed.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Defender keeps none unless the Attacker fails to win; then owners recover their own.

forks.trigger: Ward has sent a herald. He offers a Trial for the port road.
forks.consequence: Accept and fight him for clean passage, or refuse and run the port approach under fire.

tracks.name: The Trial for the Road
tracks.situation: Star Colonel Ward's offer: one of yours against him, on the open ground before the port gate. Win, and the convoy passes clean and every Wolf unit stands down. Lose, and the Wolves take the archive as isorla and you leave with what you carry. The Wolves have kept every promise they made on Rasalhague. Thorvaldsen has left the choice to you.
tracks.deployment: Duel ground: the open plaza before the port gate, 8 hexes across, clear terrain. Your champion (any one unit) and Ward's Timber Wolf begin 6 hexes apart. No other unit may enter the plaza or fire into it. If you REFUSE the Trial, this track is instead fought as a Breakthrough: you (Attacker) enter Turn 1 against the full Wolf force set up at the port gate, with the convoy behind you.

objectives.text: Trial Won — your champion cripples or destroys Ward's Timber Wolf.
Honor Held — your champion is still standing (not crippled) at end of Turn 6, win or not.
Trial Lost — Ward cripples or destroys your champion.
Refused and Forced — if the Trial is refused: exit three trucks off the port edge under fire.

tracks.specialRules: Trial rules: no outside fire, no retreat off the plaza. A Trial won clears the convoy and pays the bonus regardless of Archive Trucks. A Trial lost: the archive is taken; -2 Reputation, no bonus. If refused, standard rules apply and the tally decides.
tracks.trackEnd: Trial: when one champion is crippled or destroyed, or end of Turn 6. Refused: Turn 10.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Trial won: the Wolves release your champion's wreck if any, and one Wolf wreck as isorla in reverse. Refused: pool-draft.

forks.trigger: The Republic's archive is on a ship, or in Wolf hands.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Archive Trucks, the Trial, and Reputation.

hotspots.title: The Kobe Road
hotspots.employer: Lyran Commonwealth — Gräfin Anneliese Stromberg of Amirani (private purse)
hotspots.blurb: The Wolves are on Tamar and the Duke has shut the Guards out of his city. A Tamar noble hires you to find the Elemental head-hunters stalking the Guards' retreat through the Smitton forests — and break them before Kobe.
hotspots.situation:
Tamar is a heavy world with a thin sky and an old family that has never forgiven the Commonwealth for anything. When Clan Wolf's Alpha Galaxy arrived in November 3051, the Duke of Tamar refused to cooperate with the AFFC, refused reinforcement, and, when the Twenty-sixth Lyran Guards accepted the Wolves' batchall and held Shonick Dale for six hours before being driven back at night, refused them the gates of Tamar City. The Guards regrouped in the forests near Smitton and began a fighting withdrawal toward Kobe. The Duke is dead now, in his Atlas, and his Guard with him. The Wolves hold the capital.

The Twenty-sixth is still out there, and the Wolves are hunting them the Clan way: not with a Cluster, but with Elemental head-hunter Stars — armored infantry that penetrates a 'Mech regiment's lines in the trees, finds the command lance, and kills it. Two such Stars broke into the Guards' position at Smitton. The regiment is moving toward Kobe with its rear echelon strung out on the forest road and the head-hunters somewhere in the timber alongside it.

The Gräfin of Amirani did not agree with her Duke. She is paying you out of her own treasury to do what the Guards cannot spare a unit to do: go into the Smitton forests, find the head-hunter Stars, and break them before they reach the rear echelon. Tamar's gravity is a fifth again heavier than standard, and every jump and every fall costs more here. So does every hour the Guards spend not knowing where the Elementals are.

contract.constraints: Command Independent — the Gräfin is a patron, not a general; you report to her and to no one. Salvage Shared; the Gräfin claims one Clan wreck for her house and you keep the rest by share.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; minimum fielded force 5,000 BV / 200 PV. High gravity (1.2 g) — every unit takes the Tamar gravity rules below; no unit with less than 5 tons of armor may deploy.
contract.bonus: The Guards reach Kobe — if the Twenty-sixth's rear echelon exits Track 3 intact, the Gräfin pays +1 Reputation with the Lyran Commonwealth and a Clan salvage claim of her own choosing is released to you.

missionBrief.behindScenes: The head-hunters are two Points of Elementals under Star Captain Ilse, escorted by a Star of light OmniMechs for the road fights. They know the Guards are moving and they know the rear echelon is the soft target. In Track 1 you find them or you do not; finding them (2a) means fighting Elementals in the trees, which is nobody's idea of a good day; missing them (2b) means catching them on the Kobe road where at least you can see. Track 3 is the Guards' rear echelon crossing the last ridge, with whatever survived of the head-hunters waiting.

complications.effect: None.
Zellbrigen. A Wolf MechWarrior of the escort Star challenges your commander. Accept: one-on-one until one is crippled. Refuse or interfere: the Wolves drop honor rules for the track.
Tamar blush. The thin sky and hard sun cost every pilot: +1 to all Piloting Skill Rolls this track, both sides, on top of the gravity rules.

Guards stragglers. A Lyran Guards lance (Regular, damaged) is on the map at start, within 4 hexes of the Wolf side; it fights under your command if you reach it, or is destroyed by the head-hunters if you do not by Turn 4.
Head-hunter Point in ambush. Five Elementals begin hidden in any Heavy Woods hex on the Wolf side; they reveal when a friendly unit ends its move adjacent.
Roll twice, ignore repeats.

missionBrief.contractVictory: Break both Elemental head-hunter Points before the Twenty-sixth's rear echelon crosses the ridge to Kobe in Track 3. The Gräfin pays on the Guards arriving, not on Wolves killed — but the Guards arrive only if the head-hunters are gone.
missionBrief.tally: Head-hunters Down — each Elemental Point reduced to two or fewer suits counts 1. At 2, Track 3 has no Elemental threat and the escort Star fights alone.

namedCharacters.name: Star Captain Ilse
namedCharacters.role: OpFor commander — Clan Wolf head-hunter detachment (Elemental)
namedCharacters.rule: Leads a Point of five. Her Point begins hidden in every track it appears in. If her suit is destroyed, the remaining Elementals withdraw at the end of that turn.

namedCharacters.name: Star Commander Roth
namedCharacters.role: OpFor — escort Star, light OmniMechs
namedCharacters.rule: Commands the 'Mech escort. Will accept zellbrigen. Will not engage until the head-hunters are engaged or revealed.

namedCharacters.name: Gräfin Anneliese Stromberg
namedCharacters.role: Employer — noble house of Amirani
namedCharacters.rule: Not on the field. Pays by radio confirmation of the Guards' arrival. If the Guards' rear echelon is destroyed in Track 3, she withholds the bonus and half the base pay.

missionBrief.purchaseOptions: Between tracks, the Gräfin's house arsenal — light 'Mechs and one heavy (a Zeus, if you roll 10+) — on a 2D6 roll of 8+. She will not sell what she needs to hold Amirani.

tracks.name: The Smitton Timber
tracks.situation:
Heavy forest, high gravity, and somewhere in it two Points of Elementals who are very good at not being seen. You go in to find them before the Guards' rear echelon comes through.

Recon: you (Attacker) must scan and identify. The Elementals will not show themselves until they choose to.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Wolves (Defender) — the escort Star — set up within 6 hexes of their edge; both Elemental Points begin HIDDEN anywhere in Heavy Woods on the Wolf half and reveal when a friendly unit ends its move adjacent, or when they fire. You (Attacker) enter Turn 1. Two-thirds of the map is Light or Heavy Woods. TAMAR GRAVITY: all jump distances -1 hex; every fall inflicts +1 damage per 5 tons; Piloting Skill Rolls for standing +1.

objectives.text: Find Them — reveal both Elemental Points (by adjacency or by their fire) by end of Turn 6.
Scan the Escort — scan (identify) half the escort Star.
First Blood — reduce one Elemental Point to two or fewer suits.
Stay Hidden — at least one Elemental Point unrevealed at end of Turn 6.
Bleed the Scouts — cripple two of your units before end of Turn 6.

tracks.specialRules: Hidden Elementals may swarm a 'Mech that ends its move adjacent (standard Elemental anti-'Mech rules). Each Point reduced to two or fewer suits adds to Head-hunters Down.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 6.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Shared — the Gräfin's claim first, then your share in cash.

forks.trigger: Both Points are found. They are in the deep timber and they know you are coming.
forks.consequence: Fight the Elementals in the trees — their ground, not yours.

forks.trigger: The head-hunters slipped you. They are moving for the Kobe road ahead of the Guards.
forks.consequence: Catch them in the open on the road, where at least you can see them.

tracks.name: In the Deep Timber
tracks.situation: Both Points and the escort Star, in old-growth forest where a 'Mech cannot see thirty meters. They chose this ground. You found them anyway. Now it is a fight nobody dictates.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. Both sides set up within 6 hexes of their own edge; the whole map is Light or Heavy Woods except a single clearing at center (3 hexes clear). Elementals begin revealed. TAMAR GRAVITY rules apply.

objectives.text: Hold the Clearing — half your force within 3 hexes of the clearing at end of Turn 4.
Overpower — more non-crippled BV/PV within 6 hexes of the clearing than the enemy at end of Turn 8.
Break the Points — reduce both Elemental Points to two or fewer suits.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Commander Roth's Kit Fox.
Swarm — an Elemental Point successfully swarms and cripples one of your 'Mechs.

tracks.specialRules: Line of sight is 2 hexes in Heavy Woods, 4 in Light. Each Point reduced to two or fewer suits adds to Head-hunters Down.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8, or when one side has no non-crippled 'Mechs within 6 hexes of the clearing.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Pool-draft; the Gräfin's claim first, then your share.

forks.trigger: The Guards' rear echelon is at the last ridge before Kobe.
forks.consequence: Whatever survived of the head-hunters is waiting for it. So are you.

tracks.name: The Kobe Road
tracks.situation: The head-hunters got past you and are on the forest road toward the Guards' column. It is a road — the first open ground on Tamar you have seen — and the Elementals are moving fast with the escort Star ahead. Catch them before the column.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Wolves (Defender) set up on the road in the northern third moving toward their home edge — the escort Star ahead, both Elemental Points behind; you (Attacker) enter Turn 1 from the south. The road is paved (2 hexes wide); everything else is Light Woods. TAMAR GRAVITY rules apply.

objectives.text: Run Them Down — engage both Elemental Points before they reach the Wolf home edge.
Break the Points — reduce both Elemental Points to two or fewer suits.
Hammer — first side to cripple 25% of the enemy scores it; simultaneous, both score.
Reach the Column — exit both Elemental Points off the Wolf home edge with three or more suits each.

tracks.specialRules: Elementals on the road move at full speed; in woods they are hidden again if they end a move out of your line of sight. Each Point reduced to two or fewer suits adds to Head-hunters Down.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 6, or when both Points have exited or been broken.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Pool-draft; the Gräfin's claim first, then your share.

forks.trigger: The Guards' rear echelon is at the last ridge before Kobe.
forks.consequence: Whatever got through is waiting for it, and so are you — a step behind.

tracks.name: The Last Ridge
tracks.situation: The Twenty-sixth's rear echelon — supply vehicles, the field hospital, the regiment's damaged 'Mechs under tow — has to cross one ridge to reach Kobe. Whatever is left of the head-hunters and the escort Star holds the ridge road. You get the column through. If both Points are broken, this is a road fight against the escort alone; if not, the Elementals are in the rocks above the road.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Wolves (Defender) set up within 6 hexes of the ridge crest on their side; surviving Elemental Points begin hidden in ridge-rock hexes (Level 2 rough). You (Attacker) enter Turn 1 with the Guards' column — six vehicles (wheeled/tracked, 4 MP, 15 armor) that must exit the Wolf home edge. TAMAR GRAVITY rules apply.

objectives.text: Cross the Line — get half your force by BV/PV across the ridge crest line.
Column Through — exit four of six Guards vehicles off the Wolf home edge.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Commander Roth's Kit Fox.
Stop the Column — three or more Guards vehicles destroyed or immobilized before exiting.
Head-hunt — an Elemental Point swarms and cripples the Guards' command vehicle (marked at start).

tracks.specialRules: If Head-hunters Down is 2, no Elementals deploy. At contract close: four or more vehicles through = the Guards reach Kobe and the bonus pays; fewer = -1 Reputation and the Gräfin withholds half the base pay.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10, or when every Guards vehicle has exited or been destroyed.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Pool-draft; the Gräfin's claim first, then your share. Her released claim pays here if the bonus is earned.

forks.trigger: Kobe, or the ridge road, has the Twenty-sixth's rear echelon.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Head-hunters Down and the Gräfin's pay.

hotspots.title: Deny the Silverdale Yards
hotspots.employer: Draconis Combine — DCMS Alshain Military District (remnant command)
hotspots.blurb: Ghost Bear Alpha Galaxy has taken Alshain and the Regulars are broken. The district's last order before it lifts: wreck the northern-continent foundries so the Bears inherit rubble, and get out through the flash-storm coast.
hotspots.situation:
Alshain was the capital of a Military District and the heavy-industry heart of the Combine's Rasalhague frontier: two mineral-rich northern continents, foundries that fed the Pesht arsenals, and a shipyard on the inland Oresund Sea. In December 3051 the Ghost Bears' Alpha Galaxy came for it, and the Kanrei sent the Second Sword of Light to stand with the Sixth Alshain Regulars. The Regulars' commander answered the Bears' batchall by naming his units and refusing to say where they were. It bought nothing. The Bears split their Galaxy, took the Regulars and the Sword of Light apart separately, and the planet fell.

What is left of the district command is loading the Sword of Light's survivors onto DropShips and looking at the northern continents. The Aquilae foundries and the Oresund shipyard are intact — the Bears fought for the world without wrecking its wealth, because they mean to keep it. The Combine does not mean to let them. The last order the district can give is denial: put the foundry halls beyond repair and burn the shipyard slips, so that what the Ghost Bears took is a coastline and a name.

Your command is the denial force. The Regulars cannot do it — there are not enough of them left — and the Sword of Light is under orders to lift. You go into Silverdale's industrial belt on Aquilae with demolition charges and the Bears' garrison in the way, wreck what you can, and come out through the coast where the flash storms will cover you, or kill you. The district command will pay for what is destroyed. It cannot pay for anything else, because there will be no district tomorrow.

contract.constraints: Command House — a DCMS liaison from the district staff carries the demolition targets and the lift schedule. Salvage Exchange: nothing is taken off Alshain but you.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; minimum fielded force 5,000 BV / 200 PV. Demolition-capable — at least two units able to carry and place charges (any 'Mech with hands, or an engineering vehicle).
contract.bonus: Scorched — if both the Aquilae foundry control hall and the Oresund shipyard slips are destroyed across the tree, the district command pays +1 Reputation with the Combine and a Combine resupply at the lift point.

missionBrief.behindScenes: The Bears' garrison on Aquilae is a Trinary of Alpha Galaxy under Star Colonel Bekker, and it is guarding the foundries because the Bears intend to run them. Bekker will fight for the buildings, not for kills. If Track 1 wrecks the control hall, she pulls her Trinary to the shipyard and you must get out through the coast (2a); if the raid fails, the district orders a second try at the shipyard itself (2b), harder, with Bekker waiting. The flash storms are real: the coast throws them without warning.

complications.effect: None.
Zellbrigen. A Bear warrior challenges your commander. Accept: one-on-one until one is crippled. Refuse or interfere: the Bears drop honor rules for the track.
Flash storm. From Turn 3, a coastal storm crosses the map: visibility 2 hexes, no jumping, +2 to-hit at range, and any unit in a coastal hex at end of turn takes 5 damage from debris. Both sides.

Foundry workers. The Aquilae halls are still staffed by Combine civilians who will not leave. Any charge placed on an occupied hall costs -1 Reputation with the Combine at contract end unless the hall is evacuated first (a friendly unit ends a move adjacent before the charge).
Regulars remnant. A lance of the Sixth Alshain Regulars (Regular, damaged) is on the map at start on your side; they fight under your command and will not leave the foundries.
Roll twice, ignore repeats.

missionBrief.contractVictory: Destroy the Aquilae foundry control hall (Track 1) and the Oresund shipyard slips (Track 2b, or as the bonus target). The district pays per target destroyed; the contract completes on the foundry hall alone.
missionBrief.tally: Denied — each demolition target destroyed counts 1 (control hall, shipyard slips). At 2, the bonus pays. At 0, -1 Reputation: the Bears inherit Alshain working.

namedCharacters.name: Star Colonel Tovah Bekker
namedCharacters.role: OpFor commander — Ghost Bear Alpha Galaxy, Aquilae garrison
namedCharacters.rule: Joins from Track 1. Will accept zellbrigen. Fights to protect buildings: will not fire on a target if the shot's line passes through a foundry hall. If crippled, the Bear garrison falls back to the shipyard and Track 2a is unopposed for 2 turns.

namedCharacters.name: Chu-sa Ren Takahashi
namedCharacters.role: DCMS liaison — Alshain district staff
namedCharacters.rule: Rides with your command from Track 1 carrying the demolition plan. If destroyed, the charges may still be placed but the shipyard track (2b) is unavailable — no one knows the slip layout.

missionBrief.purchaseOptions: None on-world. The Combine resupply at the lift point (bonus) is armor and ammunition only.

tracks.name: The Aquilae Halls
tracks.situation:
Six foundry halls on the Aquilae industrial flats, one of them the control hall the whole complex runs on. Bekker's Trinary is quartered among them. Get in, find the control hall, put charges on it, and get out.

Objective raid: you (Attacker) must reach, identify and destroy a specific building. The Bears will fight for every hall.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Bears (Defender) set up in their own half among six Heavy buildings (Level 3, 60 damage / AS 8) near center — the foundry halls; one is secretly the control hall (HQ). You (Attacker) enter Turn 1. Placing a charge: a demolition-capable unit ends its move adjacent to a hall and does not fire that turn; the charge detonates at end of the next turn for 60 damage to that building. Scans identify halls (Strike reveal rules).

objectives.text: Case the Complex — scan 2 halls, or find the control hall.
Identify and Destroy — after scanning it, destroy the control hall.
Rough Up the Place — destroy half the halls.
Hold the Halls — half the Bear force within reach of the halls at end of Turn 6.
Save the Control Hall — the control hall standing at end of Turn 10.

tracks.specialRules: Bears will not fire through a hall. Each target destroyed adds to Denied. Foundry-worker complication applies here.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10, or when the control hall is destroyed and no friendly unit remains within 3 hexes of a standing hall.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Exchange — cash to you; nothing is carried off Alshain.

forks.trigger: The control hall is rubble; Bekker has pulled back to the shipyard.
forks.consequence: Get out through the coast before the storms and the Bears close it.

forks.trigger: The halls held. The district orders a second try — at the shipyard itself.
forks.consequence: Bekker is waiting at the Oresund slips. Burn them anyway.

tracks.name: The Storm Coast
tracks.situation: The foundries are burning behind you. The lift point is on the Corvi coast, across ten kilometers of shoreline where Alshain's flash storms come off the sea without warning. Bekker's Trinary is between you and the ships, thinned and angry.
tracks.deployment: Short edges, same-edge start. You (Defender) enter from the Bear edge Turn 1; the Bears (Attacker) enter their own edge Turn 2. The northern third of the map is coastal hexes (Level 0 rough). Roll 1D6 at the start of each turn from Turn 3: on a 5+ the flash-storm complication applies that turn.

objectives.text: Break Contact — exit at least one of your units off your home edge.
Gauntlet — exit half your force by count off your home edge; crippled units that make it count.
Hammer — first side to cripple 25% of the enemy scores it; simultaneous, both score.
Run Them Down — engage half your units in the coastal third by end of Turn 4.
Isorla — cripple or destroy a third of your force before it exits.

tracks.specialRules: If Bekker was crippled in Track 1, the Bears do not enter until Turn 4.
tracks.trackEnd: Turn 10.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Defender keeps none unless the Attacker fails to win; then owners recover their own.

forks.trigger: The ships lift, or they lift without you.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Denied and Reputation.

tracks.name: The Oresund Slips
tracks.situation: The foundries stand. The district will not accept that as the last word, so the second target becomes the first: the shipyard slips on the Oresund Sea, where Bekker has concentrated her Trinary. Burn the slips or Alshain builds DropShips for the Bears by spring.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Bears (Defender) set up within 6 hexes of four Heavy buildings (Level 3) on the shoreline — the slips; one is the graving dock control (HQ). You (Attacker) enter Turn 1. Demolition and scan rules as Track 1. The Oresund Sea is Depth 2 water along the Bear edge. Flash-storm roll from Turn 3 as in 2a.

objectives.text: Case the Yard — scan 2 slips, or find the graving dock control.
Identify and Destroy — after scanning it, destroy the graving dock control.
Burn the Slips — destroy three of four slip buildings.
Hold the Yard — half the Bear force within reach of the slips at end of Turn 6.
Isorla — cripple or destroy a third of your force before end of Turn 10.

tracks.specialRules: Bears will not fire through a slip building. Each target destroyed adds to Denied. If the Chu-sa was destroyed in Track 1, this track is unavailable.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10, or when the graving dock control is destroyed and no friendly unit remains within 3 hexes of a standing slip.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Exchange — cash to you.

forks.trigger: The yard is decided, and the lift will not wait.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Denied and Reputation.

hotspots.title: The Edo Tunnels
hotspots.employer: Draconis Combine — Fourteenth Legion of Vega (surviving command element)
hotspots.blurb: The Jaguars burned Edo from orbit. Survivors are alive in the tunnels under the ruin, and a Legion of Vega officer will pay anything to get them out from under the garrison that did it.
hotspots.situation:
Turtle Bay was a Combine world near the Periphery rim, its capital a city called Edo, its garrison the Fourteenth Legion of Vega. In March 3050 Clan Smoke Jaguar's 362nd Assault Cluster came down on it. The Legion fought and was broken. A Combine officer of the blood was captured the first day and held in Edo's prison; in May he was freed through the yakuza tunnels under the city and got offworld while the streets burned in guerrilla fighting to cover him.

The Jaguars answered the humiliation the way the Jaguars answer things. Their WarShips razed Edo from orbit. More than a million people died in a city that had done nothing but sit on the ground where a prisoner escaped. The Inner Sphere has a word for it now — the Turtle Bay Massacre — and the Combine has a debt it will spend a decade paying.

But Edo was built on tunnels, and tunnels survive what cities do not. There are people alive under the ruin: Legion wounded who never made it to a ship, yakuza who ran the tunnels and now run them as shelters, families who went down when the sky lit up. The Jaguar garrison is on the surface, and it hunts anything that surfaces. A chu-sa of the Fourteenth who got out in May has come back with a DropShip, no orders, and a contract. She wants the tunnel survivors brought to her ship before the Jaguars find the entrances. There is no glory in this and no salvage. There are people, and a way out, and a Cluster that would rather they did not take it.

contract.constraints: Command Independent — the chu-sa is not your commander and has no chain to answer to. Salvage None: you will not loot Edo, and she will not pay anyone who tries.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; minimum fielded force 4,500 BV / 180 PV. Transport-capable — at least two units able to carry infantry or wounded (APCs, or 'Mechs with hands and a will).
contract.bonus: Everyone out — if every survivor group reaches the ship across the tree, the chu-sa pays +2 Reputation with the Combine, and the Legion of Vega remembers. That is not a small thing in the Combine.

missionBrief.behindScenes: Star Captain Osis commands the surface garrison — a Binary of Jaguars who consider this world settled and its survivors beneath notice until they surface. There are three tunnel groups: Legion wounded under the old prison, yakuza and families under the market district, and a mixed group under the spaceport ruin. Track 1 is reaching them. If it goes well the Jaguars have not yet noticed and you run for the ship (2a); if the Jaguars are alerted they find the ship and you must hold the field while it loads (2b).

complications.effect: None.
Zellbrigen. A Jaguar warrior challenges your commander. Accept: one-on-one until one is crippled. Refuse or interfere: the Jaguars drop honor rules for the track.
Ruin collapse. Any building hex entered this track has a 1-in-6 chance of collapsing: the entering unit takes 10 damage and the hex becomes rubble (Level 1 rough).

The prison group will not move. The Legion wounded under the old prison refuse to leave without their officer's body. A friendly unit must spend a full turn adjacent to the prison entrance before that group counts as recovered.
Jaguar patrol. One Jaguar Star is already on the map at start, within 6 hexes of a random tunnel entrance.
Roll twice, ignore repeats.

missionBrief.contractVictory: Bring the three tunnel survivor groups to the chu-sa's DropShip and lift. The contract pays per group delivered; the bonus pays on all three. Nothing else on Turtle Bay is on offer.
missionBrief.tally: Out of the Dark — each survivor group that boards the ship counts 1. At 3, the bonus pays. At 0, the contract fails and -2 Reputation: the Legion does not forget that either.

namedCharacters.name: Star Captain Jorn Osis
namedCharacters.role: OpFor commander — Smoke Jaguar surface garrison
namedCharacters.rule: Joins when the Jaguars are alerted (Track 2b, or Track 1 from Turn 6). Will accept zellbrigen. Does NOT fire on survivor groups on foot — the Jaguars consider them beneath a warrior's notice — but fires on any vehicle carrying them.

namedCharacters.name: Chu-sa Emiko Sato
namedCharacters.role: Employer — Fourteenth Legion of Vega, surviving command element
namedCharacters.rule: On the field in Track 2b only, defending her own ship. If destroyed, the ship lifts at end of the next turn with whoever is aboard, and no bonus is paid.

missionBrief.purchaseOptions: None. There is nothing left on Turtle Bay to buy.

tracks.name: Under the Ruin
tracks.situation:
Edo is rubble and ash. Three tunnel entrances are still open — the old prison, the market district, the spaceport. Reach each one, bring the people up, and get them moving toward the ship before the garrison notices anything moving at all.

Extraction: you (Attacker) must reach three points and recover what is there. Speed and quiet are the plan.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. Three tunnel entrances (marked hexes in rubble, Level 1 rough) are placed in the Jaguar half at least 6 hexes apart. A survivor group is recovered when a transport-capable friendly unit ends a move adjacent and does not fire that turn; the group then moves with that unit. The Jaguars (Defender) have NO units on the map at start; from Turn 6, or the turn after any friendly unit fires, one Jaguar Star enters from the Jaguar edge each turn (max 3). You (Attacker) enter Turn 1.

objectives.text: First Group — recover one survivor group by end of Turn 4.
All Three — recover all three survivor groups by end of Turn 8.
Quiet — no friendly unit fires before Turn 6.
Alert the Garrison — a friendly unit fires before Turn 6.
Cut the Recovery — cripple or destroy a transport-capable friendly unit carrying a survivor group.

tracks.specialRules: Ruin-collapse complication applies here. A carrying unit that is crippled drops its group in place; another transport unit may recover it. Each group carried off your home edge adds to Out of the Dark.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8, or when all three groups have been recovered and carried off your home edge.
tracks.salvagePolicy: None.

forks.trigger: The groups are up and moving. The garrison is stirring but has not found the ship.
forks.consequence: Run for the chu-sa's DropShip with the survivors and the Jaguars waking behind you.

forks.trigger: The Jaguars are alerted and have found the ship on its field.
forks.consequence: Hold the field while the ship loads, or it lifts with no one.

tracks.name: Run for the Ship
tracks.situation: The survivors are with you and the Jaguar garrison is coming awake. The chu-sa's ship is on a field outside the ruin, ramp down. Get the people there. Nothing else matters.
tracks.deployment: Short edges, same-edge start. You (Defender) and the survivor groups (moving with their carrying units) enter from the Jaguar edge Turn 1; the Jaguars (Attacker) enter their own edge Turn 2. The DropShip is a Level 3 building on your home edge; a carrying unit that ends its move adjacent to it has delivered its group.

objectives.text: Deliver — deliver two of three survivor groups to the ship.
Everyone — deliver all three groups by end of Turn 8.
Gauntlet — exit half your force by count into the ship; crippled units that make it count.
Cut the Recovery — cripple or destroy a carrying unit before it delivers.

tracks.specialRules: Jaguars will not fire on survivors on foot; a dropped group is safe until picked up again. Each group delivered adds to Out of the Dark. The ship lifts at end of Turn 8.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8.
tracks.salvagePolicy: None.

forks.trigger: The ship lifts.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; count who is aboard, settle Out of the Dark and Reputation.

tracks.name: Hold the Field
tracks.situation: The Jaguars found the ship. Osis's Binary is coming for it with the survivors still on the road behind you. The chu-sa has the ramp down and will not lift without them. You hold the field until they board.
tracks.deployment: Short edges. You (Defender) set up within 6 hexes of the DropShip on your home edge (Level 3 building; ramp hex adjacent). Surviving groups arrive on your home edge on Turns 2, 4 and 6 (one per turn, on foot, 1 MP) and must reach the ramp hex. The Jaguars (Attacker) enter Turn 1. The chu-sa's Dragon is on the field under your command.

objectives.text: Hold the Ramp — no Jaguar unit within 2 hexes of the ramp at end of any turn.
Board Them — two of three groups reach the ramp hex.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Captain Osis's Warhawk.
Take the Ramp — a Jaguar unit within 2 hexes of the ramp at end of any turn.
Ground the Ship — the DropShip building takes 60 damage.

tracks.specialRules: Jaguars will not fire on groups on foot. Each group that reaches the ramp adds to Out of the Dark. If the chu-sa's Dragon is destroyed, the ship lifts at end of the next turn.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8, or when the ship lifts.
tracks.salvagePolicy: None.

forks.trigger: The ship lifts, with whoever made it.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Out of the Dark and Reputation.

hotspots.title: The Mist Line
hotspots.employer: Draconis Combine — DCMS Wolcott defense command (the Coordinator's trap)
hotspots.blurb: The Combine has baited the Smoke Jaguars into a Trial on a fog-bound marsh hung with metal strips that blind Clan sensors. You are listed as green militia. You are the edge of the trap.
hotspots.situation:
Wolcott is a swamp with cities on the dry parts, and nobody in the Combine would have picked it for anything before the Coordinator picked it for this. The Smoke Jaguars have won every fight since March. The Combine needs one it can point to, and the Coordinator has spent months building one: a battlefield on Wolcott's eastern marsh where the fog never lifts, the trees stand close, and every trunk is hung with strips of reflective metal that turn a Clan OmniMech's superior sensors into noise. Range is the Clans' edge. On the mist line there is no range.

The bait is the defenders. Two elite regiments have been moved to Wolcott and listed, in every record the Jaguars can steal, as green garrison troops. The Jaguars will bid to match green troops. They will come down light, and proud, and find the Genyosha waiting in the fog. But a trap needs a frame, and the frame is the flanks — units that look like exactly what the records say, holding the marsh edges so the Jaguars commit to the center.

That is you. Your command is on the books as a militia battalion. You hold the eastern marsh flank under the strips, in the fog, and when the Jaguars come through you fight them where they cannot see and cannot shoot past forty meters. The batchall has been answered: if the Jaguars win, the planet; if the Combine wins, four OmniMechs and two dozen suits of Elemental armor, surrendered. The Combine intends to collect. It has hired you to make sure the collection happens on the flank it cannot spare a regiment for.

contract.constraints: Command House — the Wolcott defense staff directs the trap and you hold your assigned line; no unit may leave the marsh flank without orders. Salvage Shared: the surrendered isorla belongs to the Combine, but your share is a claim on it.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; minimum fielded force 5,500 BV / 220 PV. Marsh-capable — no hover; every unit must be able to fight in Depth 1 water and fog.
contract.bonus: The Trial won — if the Jaguars are beaten across the tree and the isorla surrendered, your salvage share is paid as ONE of the four surrendered OmniMechs, chosen by the Combine, plus +1 Reputation with the Combine. A Clan machine, in 3050, is a fortune.

missionBrief.behindScenes: Star Colonel Howell's Trinary bid against 'green militia' and got you. Under the strips his OmniMechs' range and sensors are gone; the fight is at knife range in fog, which is the Combine's whole plan. If Track 1 breaks the Jaguar push on your flank, Howell falls back on his DropShips and the Genyosha have the center — run him down (2a). If the flank bends, Howell re-bids upward (the Jaguars can do that mid-Trial) and comes back harder (2b). Track 3 is the surrender of the isorla — and a Jaguar who will not give up his machine without a Trial of Possession.

complications.effect: None.

Zellbrigen in the fog. A Jaguar warrior challenges your commander by radio — he cannot see you. Accept: the two must find each other; one-on-one once within 3 hexes. Refuse: the Jaguars drop honor rules for the track.
The strips fail. A section of the reflective strips has fallen; a 4-hex band across the map has normal Clan sensor and range rules this track.
Elementals in the water. A Point of five Elementals begins hidden in any Depth 1 water hex on the Jaguar side; reveals when adjacent to a friendly unit.
Genyosha lance. A lance of the Genyosha (Elite) arrives on your flank from the center on Turn 4 under your command — the trap is springing and they want the flank sealed.
Roll twice, ignore repeats.

missionBrief.contractVictory: Hold the eastern marsh flank through the Trial so the Jaguars commit to the center and lose. The contract pays on the Trial's outcome across the tree; the bonus pays on the isorla surrendered and your share claimed in Track 3.
missionBrief.tally: Flank Held — each track you win counts 1. At 2+, the Combine wins the Trial and Track 3's isorla surrender happens. At 0, the Jaguars win the Trial; Track 3 is unavailable and -1 Reputation.

namedCharacters.name: Star Colonel Brannoch Howell
namedCharacters.role: OpFor commander — Smoke Jaguar Trinary on the eastern marsh
namedCharacters.rule: Joins from Track 1. Will accept zellbrigen. Under the strips his Dire Wolf's range advantage is gone — treat all his weapons as maximum range 4 hexes. If crippled, the Jaguars do not re-bid in Track 2b.

namedCharacters.name: Sho-sa Kenji Watanabe
namedCharacters.role: DCMS liaison — Wolcott defense staff
namedCharacters.rule: On the field from Track 1. Carries the trap's timing; if destroyed, the Genyosha-lance complication cannot occur and Track 2a's pursuit begins 2 turns late.

namedCharacters.name: MechWarrior Tavin
namedCharacters.role: OpFor — the Jaguar who will not surrender his machine (Track 3)
namedCharacters.rule: Track 3 only. Demands a Trial of Possession for his Summoner rather than hand it over. If he wins, the Combine keeps only three OmniMechs and your share is cash. If he loses, the Summoner is yours.

missionBrief.purchaseOptions: Between tracks, the Wolcott depot — light and medium 'Mechs and tracked vehicles, on a 2D6 roll of 8+. After a Combine Trial win, one item from the surrendered Elemental armor may be bought at Combine cost.

tracks.name: Under the Strips
tracks.situation:
The eastern marsh. Fog to the treetops, water to the knee, and metal strips turning every scan into static. The Jaguars come through expecting green militia. Nobody dictates this fight; it happens where the two sides find each other.

Meeting engagement: both sides advance into ground neither holds. Under the strips, the Clan's range is gone.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. Both sides set up within 6 hexes of their own edge. The whole map is Light Woods over Depth 1 water except a raised causeway (2 hexes, clear) at center. THE STRIPS: line of sight is 4 hexes for every unit; no weapon may fire beyond 4 hexes; no indirect fire; no aerospace. Heat sinks in Depth 1 water function normally.

objectives.text: Hold the Causeway — half your force within 3 hexes of the causeway at end of Turn 4.
Overpower — more non-crippled BV/PV within 6 hexes of the causeway than the enemy at end of Turn 8.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Colonel Howell's Dire Wolf.
Break the Militia — cripple or destroy a third of your force by count.

tracks.specialRules: Strips rules apply to both sides. A track win adds to Flank Held.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8, or when one side has no non-crippled 'Mechs within 6 hexes of the causeway.
