tracks.salvagePolicy: Shared — the Combine's claim first; your share is a claim on the isorla (Track 3), else cash.

forks.trigger: The Jaguar push on your flank broke; the Genyosha have the center. Howell is falling back on his ships.
forks.consequence: Run him down through the marsh before he lifts — the isorla is only owed if the Trial is finished.

forks.trigger: Your flank bent. Howell has re-bid upward and is coming back with a second Trinary.
forks.consequence: Hold the marsh edge or the trap springs on nothing.

tracks.name: Through the Marsh
tracks.situation: Howell's Trinary is retreating through the marsh toward its DropShips, and the Trial is not over until it is finished — a Jaguar who lifts unbeaten owes nothing. Catch them in the water and the isorla is owed.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Jaguars (Defender) set up in the northern third moving toward their home edge; you (Attacker) enter Turn 1 from the south. Map as Track 1 — Light Woods over Depth 1 water, strips rules apply (LOS and range 4 hexes). The Jaguar home edge is dry ground (clear).

objectives.text: Run Them Down — engage half the Jaguar force before it reaches dry ground.
Finish the Trial — cripple or destroy a third of the Jaguar force by count before it exits.
Hammer — first side to cripple 25% of the enemy scores it; simultaneous, both score.
Lift Unbeaten — exit half the Jaguar force by BV off the Jaguar home edge.

tracks.specialRules: Strips rules apply. If the Sho-sa was destroyed in Track 1, you enter on Turn 3. A track win adds to Flank Held.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 6, or when the Jaguars have no non-crippled unit in the water.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Pool-draft; the Combine's claim first, your share as a claim on the isorla.

forks.trigger: The Trial is finished. The Jaguars owe four OmniMechs and two dozen suits — and one warrior will not hand his over.
forks.consequence: A Trial of Possession for a Summoner. Win it and the machine is yours.

tracks.name: The Marsh Edge
tracks.situation: Howell re-bid — a second Trinary, and this time he knows the flank is not militia. If the marsh edge falls the Jaguars roll up the Genyosha's flank and the Coordinator's trap springs on empty fog. Hold the edge.
tracks.deployment: Short edges. You (Defender) set up within 6 hexes of your home edge along the marsh edge — the southern third is dry ground (Light Woods, clear); the rest is Depth 1 water under the strips. The Jaguars (Attacker) enter Turn 1 through the water. Strips rules apply in water hexes only; on dry ground normal rules.

objectives.text: Hold the Edge — half your force on dry ground within 4 hexes of your edge by Turn 4.
Overpower — more non-crippled BV/PV on dry ground than the Jaguars at end of Turn 8.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Colonel Howell's Dire Wolf.
Roll the Flank — exit a third of the Jaguar force by BV off your home edge.

tracks.specialRules: Jaguar units on dry ground regain full range and sensors. A track win adds to Flank Held.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 8, or when one side has no non-crippled 'Mechs on dry ground.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Winner-all (paid as SP at your salvage %); the Combine's claim first.

forks.trigger: The edge held and the Genyosha closed the center. The Jaguars owe the isorla — and one warrior refuses.
forks.consequence: A Trial of Possession for a Summoner. Win it and the machine is yours.

forks.trigger: The flank fell. The trap closed on fog.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; the Jaguars keep Wolcott. Settle Flank Held and Reputation.

tracks.name: The Trial of Possession
tracks.situation: The Jaguars lost the Trial and are surrendering the isorla on the Wolcott spaceport apron — four OmniMechs and the Elemental suits, walked out and handed over under the eyes of both sides. Three of the four are given up. The fourth MechWarrior, Tavin, has declared a Trial of Possession: his Summoner is his, and the Combine, or its hired militia, may fight him for it. The Combine has handed the fight to you. Win, and your share of the isorla is a Clan OmniMech.
tracks.deployment: Duel ground: the spaceport apron, 10 hexes across, clear, dry — no strips, full range for both. Your champion (any one unit) and Tavin's Summoner begin 8 hexes apart. No other unit may enter the apron or fire into it. Both sides watch.

objectives.text: Possession — your champion cripples or destroys Tavin's Summoner.
Honor Held — your champion is not crippled at end of Turn 8, win or not.
Kept — Tavin cripples or destroys your champion.

tracks.specialRules: Trial rules: no outside fire, no retreat off the apron. Won: the Summoner is repaired at Combine cost and delivered as your salvage share (the bonus). Lost: the Combine keeps three OmniMechs; your share is cash at Shared rate. Either way, +1 Reputation with the Combine for a Trial fought clean.
tracks.trackEnd: When one champion is crippled or destroyed, or end of Turn 8 (a draw: Tavin keeps his machine).
tracks.salvagePolicy: The Trial decides it: won = the Summoner; lost or drawn = cash.

forks.trigger: The isorla is handed over, one way or the other.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Flank Held, the Trial, and Reputation.

hotspots.title: The Kado-guchi Valley
hotspots.employer: Draconis Combine — DCMS high command (the defense of the Imperial City)
hotspots.blurb: January 3052. Two Clans, twenty-five Clusters, the Combine's capital. Thirty regiments hold the approaches to Imperial City and you are one of them. Two days decide the Dragon.
hotspots.situation:
Luthien is the Dragon's throne and the Dragon's forge — a world of ferrocrete and foundry smoke where the Combine builds its armies and keeps its Coordinator. In January 3052 Clans Smoke Jaguar and Nova Cat come for it together: twenty-five Clusters against everything the Combine can put on the ground, thirty regiments of House troops and hired mercenaries, on the approaches to Imperial City. If the city falls the Combine loses its head and the Pesht Military District loses its heart. If it holds, the Clans have been stopped at a capital for the first time.

The approaches are valleys. The Kado-guchi valley runs from the Clan landing zones toward the city's eastern quarter across open ground, then broken ground, then the first ferrocrete of the industrial belt. It is one of a dozen such approaches and one of the ones the Combine can least afford to lose, because the eastern quarter backs onto the road to the Luthien Armor Works. The DCMS has put a regiment in the valley. It has put you beside them.

Your contract is the valley for two days. Day one, the Jaguars come up it and you hold. Day two, one of two things happens: the line has held and the Combine counterattacks into the Nova Cat salient on the valley's shoulder, or the line has bent and you fall back onto the ferrocrete and hold there. Either way the last hours are at the city's edge, where the Clans make their final push and the Combine finds out what it is. The pay is a fortune, the terms are the Combine's, and the Dragon's Tears will remember every name that stood here.

contract.constraints: Command House — the DCMS valley commander directs the defense; you hold your sector and move on his word. Salvage Shared: every Clan wreck on Luthien belongs to the Combine first; your share is real and it will be paid.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 3; minimum fielded force 8,000 BV / 320 PV. Nothing under a battalion is on this field.
contract.bonus: The city holds — if Imperial City stands at the end of the tree, the Combine pays +2 Reputation, a Clan-salvage voucher (one captured OmniMech chassis released to you), and your unit's name goes on the Dragon's Tears memorial. That last one is not a bonus you can spend. It is worth more than the ones you can.

missionBrief.behindScenes: The Kado-guchi valley is a Jaguar axis on day one under Star Colonel Kotare — a full Cluster bid against a regiment and a merc command. The Nova Cats hold the valley's northern shoulder under Star Colonel Nostra, and they fight strangely: patient, then sudden, as if they already know the shape of the fight. If day one holds (Track 1), the Combine counterattacks into the Cat salient on day two (2a). If the line bends, day two is the ferrocrete (2b). Track 3 is the final push at the eastern quarter, and both Clans send what they have left.

complications.effect: None.
Zellbrigen. A Clan warrior challenges your commander. Accept: one-on-one until one is crippled. Refuse or interfere: that Clan drops honor rules for the track.
Black Luthien. Foundry smog rolls down the valley: visibility 6 hexes, +1 to-hit at long range, both sides, all track.
Elemental Point. Five Elementals begin hidden in any broken-ground hex on the Clan side; reveal when adjacent to a friendly unit.
The regiment's reserve. A DCMS lance (Veteran, heavy 'Mechs) is released to your sector on Turn 4 under your command.
Roll twice, ignore repeats.

missionBrief.contractVictory: Imperial City stands at the end of Track 3. The valley is held or lost track by track; the contract pays on the capital. Combat pay is per-track tier at Scale 3 — the highest tier reached each track, times three.
missionBrief.tally: Valley Ground — each track you win counts 1. At 2+, the eastern quarter holds and the city stands. At 0, the Clans reach the ferrocrete with the Armor Works road open: Track 3 begins one objective easier for the Clans.

namedCharacters.name: Star Colonel Reth Kotare
namedCharacters.role: OpFor commander — Smoke Jaguar, Kado-guchi axis
namedCharacters.rule: Joins from Track 1 (Jaguar tracks). Will accept zellbrigen. If crippled, the Jaguar force is -2 Initiative for the rest of that track and Track 3's Jaguar element enters 2 turns late.

namedCharacters.name: Star Colonel Sela Nostra
namedCharacters.role: OpFor commander — Nova Cat, the northern shoulder
namedCharacters.rule: Joins in Nova Cat tracks (2a, 3). Will accept zellbrigen. The Nova Cats do not enter until Turn 2 of any track they appear in, and then all at once.

namedCharacters.name: Tai-sa Hideo Akiyama
namedCharacters.role: DCMS valley commander — the regiment beside you
namedCharacters.rule: On the field from Track 1. Directs the defense; the reserve-lance complication is his. If destroyed, the regiment is -2 Initiative for the rest of the track and the counterattack (2a) is unavailable — the tree goes to 2b.

missionBrief.purchaseOptions: Between tracks, the Luthien Armor Works itself — any Combine 'Mech up to assault, on a 2D6 roll of 7+ (the Works are running flat out). After a Clan wreck is recovered, Combine techs will fit one Clan weapon to one of your 'Mechs at cost.

tracks.name: Day One — The Valley Floor
tracks.situation:
Open ground giving way to broken ground, and a Jaguar Cluster coming up it. You and the regiment hold the valley floor. If it falls today there is no day two.

Defend: you (Defender) hold ground against a stronger enemy, at Scale 3, with a regiment on your flank.
tracks.deployment: Short edges. You (Defender) and the DCMS regiment (one company, Veteran, under Akiyama, on your flank under your command) set up within 8 hexes of your home edge; the southern half is clear, the northern half broken ground (Level 1 rough). The Jaguars (Attacker) enter Turn 1. Artillery permitted both sides from Turn 3. No aerospace (the Combine's fighters are over the city).

objectives.text: Hold the Floor — half your force within 6 hexes of your home edge at end of Turn 4.
Overpower — more non-crippled BV/PV in your half than the Jaguars at end of Turn 10.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Colonel Kotare's Dire Wolf.
Up the Valley — exit a third of the Jaguar force by BV off your home edge.
Break the Regiment — cripple or destroy Tai-sa Akiyama's Atlas.

tracks.specialRules: The regiment company fights under your command. A track win adds to Valley Ground.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10, or when one side has no non-crippled 'Mechs in the defender's half.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Shared — the Combine's claim first; your share paid as SP, plus the voucher if earned.

forks.trigger: Day one held. Akiyama has orders: counterattack the Nova Cat salient on the northern shoulder at dawn.
forks.consequence: Go up the shoulder into the Cats — the first Combine attack of the battle.

forks.trigger: The floor is lost. You fell back onto the industrial belt overnight.
forks.consequence: Hold the ferrocrete. Behind it is the Armor Works road.

tracks.name: Day Two — The Cat Salient
tracks.situation: The Nova Cats hold the valley's northern shoulder, a salient of broken ridges that overlooks the whole floor. The Combine attacks it at dawn — the first time on Luthien anyone has gone forward. The Cats will be waiting. The Cats are always waiting.
tracks.deployment: Short edges. The Nova Cats (Defender) set up within 8 hexes of their home edge on the ridges (Level 2 rough, Light Woods); they do NOT deploy until Turn 2, and then all at once. You (Attacker) and the regiment company enter Turn 1. Artillery both sides.

objectives.text: Onto the Shoulder — get half your force by BV/PV onto Level 2 ridge hexes by end of Turn 5.
Take the Salient — more non-crippled BV/PV on the ridges than the Cats at end of Turn 10.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Colonel Nostra's Warhawk.
Hold the Ridges — no attacker unit on a ridge hex at end of Turn 5.
Throw Them Back — cripple or destroy a third of the attacking force by count.

tracks.specialRules: Nova Cats enter Turn 2. A track win adds to Valley Ground.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10, or when one side has no non-crippled 'Mechs on the ridges.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Pool-draft; the Combine's claim first, your share as SP.

forks.trigger: Both Clans are gathering everything they have left for one push at the eastern quarter.
forks.consequence: The last hours at the city's edge.

tracks.name: Day Two — The Ferrocrete
tracks.situation: The valley floor is theirs. You are on the industrial belt — foundry blocks, ferrocrete yards, the first buildings of the eastern quarter — and the Jaguars are coming into them. Behind you is the road to the Armor Works. Push them back out of the belt or the road opens.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Jaguars (Attacker) set up within 4 hexes of the belt's outer blocks — six Heavy buildings (Level 3) across the center — having taken them overnight. You (Defender) enter Turn 1 from your home edge with the regiment company. Streets paved; buildings Level 3. Artillery both sides; none into building hexes.

objectives.text: Push — hold three of the six belt buildings at end of Turn 5.
Clear the Belt — no non-crippled Jaguar unit within 2 hexes of any belt building at end of Turn 10.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy Star Colonel Kotare's Dire Wolf.
Hold the Belt — a Jaguar unit within 2 hexes of a belt building at end of Turn 10.
The Works Road — exit a Jaguar unit off your home edge.

tracks.specialRules: A track win adds to Valley Ground.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Pool-draft; the Combine's claim first, your share as SP.

forks.trigger: Both Clans are gathering everything they have left for one push at the eastern quarter.
forks.consequence: The last hours at the city's edge, on the back foot.

tracks.name: The Eastern Quarter
tracks.situation: The Clans have been on Luthien two days and it has cost them more than anything since they crossed the rim. They make one push at the eastern quarter with what is left — Jaguars and Cats together, no more bidding, no more Trials. The Combine meets it with everything in the valley. Whoever holds the quarter's edge at the end holds Imperial City.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. Both sides set up within 8 hexes of their own edge; the quarter's edge is a line of Heavy buildings (Level 3) across the center with paved streets between. The Nova Cat element (half the OpFor) enters Turn 2. Artillery both sides; none into building hexes. If Valley Ground is 0, the Clans set up 4 hexes further forward.

objectives.text: Hold the Edge — half your force within 3 hexes of the quarter's edge at end of Turn 5.
Overpower — more non-crippled BV/PV within 6 hexes of the edge than the enemy at end of Turn 12.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy either Star Colonel (Kotare or Nostra).
Into the City — exit a third of the Clan force by BV off your home edge.

tracks.specialRules: At contract close: the quarter held = Imperial City stands, the bonus pays, and your name goes on the Dragon's Tears. The quarter lost = the Clans are in the city; the contract pays base only and -2 Reputation with the Combine.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 12, or when one side has no non-crippled 'Mechs within 6 hexes of the edge.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Pool-draft; the Combine's claim first, your share as SP. The voucher pays here if the city holds.

forks.trigger: The Clans lift, or the Combine's capital is theirs.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Valley Ground, the voucher, and Reputation.

hotspots.title: Tengoku's Shadow
hotspots.employer: Draconis Combine — Eighteenth Dieron Regulars (surviving command element)
hotspots.blurb: The Nova Cats took Irece without bidding and are about to raze the last LAM factory in the Inner Sphere. The Regulars' survivors hire you to hit the Cat laager under Mount Tengoku and pull LexaTech's engineers out before the fires.
hotspots.situation:
Irece has one thing nowhere else in the Inner Sphere has: LexaTech Industries, the last factory still building Land-Air 'Mechs, on the plain below Mount Tengoku, a peak so tall its summit is in the stratosphere. In December 3051 Clan Nova Cat's Beta Galaxy came for it. The Eighteenth Dieron Regulars answered the batchall and asked to fight outside the LexaTech grounds to spare the plant. The Nova Cat commander refused to bid at all and attacked with the whole Galaxy. The Regulars were destroyed. The planet fell in days.

The Cats have not razed the factory yet. They will — their warriors regard the LAM as an abomination and there are reports they have begun melting the control chips by hand — but for now the plant stands, its engineering staff confined inside it, and the Galaxy's supply laager sits in the mountain's shadow between the factory and the coast. What is left of the Regulars' command got offworld with two DropShips and a debt. They have come back for the engineers. A LAM factory can be rebuilt somewhere if the people who know how are alive.

Your contract is the shadow of Tengoku. Strike the laager first — wreck the Cats' fuel and field repair before they can respond in strength — then reach the plant and bring the LexaTech staff out to the Regulars' ships on the coast. The Cats will answer; the question is how fast, and whether the laager is burning when they do. There is no honor on offer here, no Trial. The Nova Cats did not bid for Irece and they will not bid for this.

contract.constraints: Command Independent — the Regulars' surviving officers are passengers on their own ships, not a staff. Salvage Exchange: nothing is carried off Irece but people.
contract.additionalRequirements: Track Scale 2 or higher; minimum fielded force 5,000 BV / 200 PV. Transport-capable — at least two units able to carry personnel out of the plant.
contract.bonus: The engineers out — if the LexaTech staff reach the Regulars' ships (Track 2a), the Combine pays +2 Reputation and a standing claim: when a LAM line is rebuilt, one of the first machines is yours.

missionBrief.behindScenes: The Cat laager under Tengoku is guarded by a Trinary under Star Captain Vashti; the plant itself by a Star. The Cats do not expect a raid — Irece is settled, in their reading. Wreck the laager's fuel store in Track 1 and the Galaxy cannot respond in strength for a day: you reach the plant (2a). Fail, and Vashti's Trinary is on you in force and you run for the coast (2b) with no engineers. The Cats fight without bidding here and without restraint; they will fire on the transports.

complications.effect: None.
No zellbrigen. The Nova Cats offer no challenges and honor no restraint this track — they mass fire from Turn 1. (Replaces the usual zellbrigen roll.)
Tengoku's shadow. The mountain blocks the sun over the laager from Turn 5: night rules, +1 to-hit at medium and long range.
Elemental Point at the fuel store. Five Elementals begin hidden adjacent to the fuel-store building; reveal when a friendly unit ends its move adjacent.
Regulars remnant. A lance of the Eighteenth Dieron Regulars (Veteran, damaged) that never got out is hiding in the foothills; it joins you from your short edge on Turn 3.
Roll twice, ignore repeats.

missionBrief.contractVictory: Wreck the Nova Cat laager's fuel store (Track 1) and bring the LexaTech engineering staff to the Regulars' ships (Track 2a). The contract completes on the laager; the bonus pays on the engineers.
missionBrief.tally: Out of the Shadow — the fuel store destroyed counts 1; the engineers delivered counts 2. At 3, the bonus pays. At 0, -1 Reputation: the Regulars came back for nothing.

namedCharacters.name: Star Captain Vashti
namedCharacters.role: OpFor commander — Nova Cat Beta Galaxy, Tengoku laager guard
namedCharacters.rule: Joins from Track 1. Offers NO zellbrigen and fires on transports. If crippled, the laager guard falls back into the foothills and Track 2a begins with the plant guard alone.

namedCharacters.name: Chu-sa Nadia Ferreira
namedCharacters.role: Employer — Eighteenth Dieron Regulars, surviving command element
namedCharacters.rule: Not on the field. Her ships are on the coast and lift at the end of Track 2. If the engineers are not aboard, she lifts without them and pays base only.

namedCharacters.name: Dr. Ines Almeida
namedCharacters.role: LexaTech chief engineer — the person the contract is for
namedCharacters.rule: Confined in the plant (Track 2a). She and her staff count as one survivor group; a transport-capable unit adjacent to the plant's main hall for a full turn recovers them. If the hall is destroyed before recovery, they are lost.

missionBrief.purchaseOptions: None on-world. The Regulars' ships carry ammunition and armor for your units at Combine cost, loaded before lift.

tracks.name: The Laager Under Tengoku
tracks.situation:
The Cat laager sits in the mountain's shadow — fuel, ammunition, the mobile bays that keep a Galaxy's OmniMechs moving. Wreck the fuel store and the Galaxy is on foot for a day. That day is the engineers' whole chance.

Strike: you (Attacker) must find and destroy one building among several, fast, and get clear.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Cats (Defender) set up in their own half with five Medium buildings (Level 2, 30 damage / AS 6) near center — the laager; one is secretly the fuel store (HQ). You (Attacker) enter half on your home edge Turn 1, the rest from a short edge Turn 2. Building scans use the Strike reveal rules. Mount Tengoku's slope is the Cat home edge (Level 3 rough, impassable beyond).

objectives.text: Case the Laager — scan 2 buildings, or find the fuel store.
Identify and Destroy — after scanning it, destroy the fuel store.
Rough Up the Place — destroy half the buildings.
Hold the Laager — half the Cat force within reach of the buildings at end of Turn 6.
Cut Off the Head — cripple or destroy your command's unit.

tracks.specialRules: The fuel store, if destroyed, burns: every unit within 2 hexes takes 15 damage and the hex is impassable for the rest of the track. Fuel store destroyed adds 1 to Out of the Shadow.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10, or when the fuel store is destroyed and no friendly unit is within 3 hexes of a standing building.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Exchange — cash to you; nothing leaves Irece.

forks.trigger: The fuel store is burning. The Galaxy is on foot for a day.
forks.consequence: Reach the plant, bring the engineers out, and run for the coast before the day ends.

forks.trigger: The laager held. Vashti's Trinary is on you in force.
forks.consequence: Run for the coast with nothing. The engineers stay.

tracks.name: The LexaTech Plant
tracks.situation: The LAM plant on the plain, a Star of Nova Cats guarding it, and inside the main hall the people who know how to build the last Land-Air 'Mech in the Inner Sphere. Get them out. The Cats will not spare the hall if they think you are winning.
tracks.deployment: Long edges. The Cats (Defender) — one Star — set up within 4 hexes of the plant: three Heavy buildings (Level 3) at center, the main hall marked. You (Attacker) enter Turn 1. Recovery: a transport-capable unit ends a move adjacent to the main hall and does not fire for a full turn; the engineers then move with it. Regulars' ships are on your home edge (Level 3 building); a carrying unit adjacent to it has delivered. If Vashti was crippled in Track 1, no reinforcements arrive.

objectives.text: Reach the Hall — a transport-capable friendly unit adjacent to the main hall by end of Turn 4.
Recover — the engineers recovered by end of Turn 6.
Deliver — the engineers delivered to the ships by end of Turn 10.
Burn the Hall — destroy the main hall before the engineers are recovered.
Cut the Recovery — cripple or destroy the carrying unit before it delivers.

tracks.specialRules: Cats fire on transports. Unless Vashti was crippled, a second Cat Star enters from the Cat edge on Turn 5. Engineers delivered adds 2 to Out of the Shadow.
tracks.trackEnd: End of Turn 10, or when the engineers are delivered or the main hall is destroyed with them inside.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Exchange — cash to you.

forks.trigger: The Regulars' ships lift.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Out of the Shadow and Reputation.

tracks.name: The Coast Road
tracks.situation: The laager stands and the Galaxy is moving. Vashti's Trinary is behind you and the coast is twenty kilometers off. There is no second try at the plant. Get your command to the ships.
tracks.deployment: Short edges, same-edge start. You (Defender) enter from the Cat edge Turn 1; the Cats (Attacker) enter their own edge Turn 2. The road is paved; either side is Light Woods and foothills (Level 1 rough). The Regulars' ships are on your home edge.

objectives.text: Break Contact — exit at least one of your units off your home edge.
Gauntlet — exit half your force by count off your home edge; crippled units that make it count.
Hammer — first side to cripple 25% of the enemy scores it; simultaneous, both score.
Run Them Down — engage half your units on the road by end of Turn 4.
No One Leaves — cripple or destroy half your force before it exits.

tracks.specialRules: Cats offer no restraint. The ships lift at end of Turn 10 with whoever is aboard.
tracks.trackEnd: Turn 10.
tracks.salvagePolicy: Defender keeps none unless the Attacker fails to win; then owners recover their own.

forks.trigger: The ships lift, without the engineers.
forks.consequence: Contract closes; settle Out of the Shadow and Reputation.
